limitations: One training seed; paired game intervals do not measure training-seed variability.
Strength is measured against the fixed training opponent on this deck.
Physical executions exceed unique committed attempts due interrupted round 8 recollection and late/fallback work.
40k vs 4k compares two checkpoints from one trajectory with more rounds and optimizer steps; it does not isolate larger dataset size from additional optimization.
Comparisons are each policy versus the same baseline, not 40k-versus-4k head-to-head.
